What to do, where to go

Oct 13, 2026

 

TOP PICKS

  1. 10/16 - Oktoberfest Cape Coral – German-themed celebration at the German American Social Club of Cape Coral available Oct. 16-18 & Oct. 23-25 with multiple entry times. Celebrate Oktoberfest with German food, imported beer, live bands, polka dancing, carnival rides, handmade crafts, and festive fun for the whole family. Tickets start at $10.00. 2101 SW Pine Island Road, Cape Coral. 239-283-1400 or gasc-capecoral.com.

  2. 10/17 - Farmer Mike’s 12th Annual Fall Festival – At Farmer Mike’s U-Pick of Bonita Springs every weekend through the month of October with multiple operating times. Navigate a five-acre corn maze, enjoy festive food and vendors, and pick sunflowers, wildflowers, and pumpkins. 26031 Morton Ave., Bonita Springs. 239-498-4576 or farmermikesupick.com.

  3. 10/18 -The Shark is Broken – Drama production at Off Broadway Palm available Oct. 16 – Nov. 14 with multiple showtimes. Go behind the scenes of Jaws as three actors trapped on a boat spar over egos, alcohol, and artistic frustration while a mechanical shark breaks down. Tickets start at $35.00. 1380 Colonial Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-278-4422 or broadwaypalm.com.

WEDNESDAY 10.14

FGCU Academy Lecture: The Rise of AI – At Sidney & Berne Davis Art Center at 1:30 p.m. Explore AI’s history, how it works, and everyday uses in an accessible lecture featuring a live ChatGPT demo; no technical background needed. Tickets are $42.00. 2301 First St., Fort Myers. 239-333-1933 or sbdac.com.

Tommy Lee Cook & The Buckingham Blues Band – Live music at The Buckingham Blues Bar at 8 p.m. Catch Tommy Lee Cook & The Buckingham Blues Band for a high-energy night of blues, big riffs, and soulful grooves. 5641 Buckingham Road, Fort Myers. 239-693-7111 or buckinghambar.com.

THURSDAY 10.15

Rhinestone Cowgirls – Live performance at Music & Arts Community Center at 2 p.m. & 7 p.m. Rhinestone Cowgirls celebrates country’s legendary women with three powerhouse singers performing classic and contemporary hits for all ages. Tickets start at $76.00. 13411 Shire Lane, Fort Myers. 239-277-1700 or gulfcoastsymphony.org.

Luke McMaster – Live performance at Tribby Arts Center at 7 p.m. Luke McMaster celebrates Motown’s influence with soulful classics, original songs, and firsthand stories of collaborating with music legends. Tickets start at $50.00. 17281 On Par Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-415-5667 or tribbyartscenter.com.

Zach Bartholomew: Nancy Wilson & Cannonball Adderley – Jazz performance at Arts Bonita’s Moe Auditorium at 7 p.m. Enjoy soulful vocals, expressive saxophone, and swinging piano in a classic tribute filled with melodies, timeless songs, and captivating storytelling. Tickets start at $38.00.  10150 Bonita Beach Road, Bonita Springs. 239-495-8989 or artsbonita.org.

FRIDAY 10.16

Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA – Live tribute performance at Music & Arts Community Center at 6 p.m. Enjoy Queen and ABBA classics by candlelight as Listeso String Quartet performs at the Music & Arts Community Center in Fort Myers. Tickets start at $43.00. 13411 Shire Lane, Fort Myers. 239-277-1700 or gulfcoastsymphony.org.

Music Walk – Community event at Downtown Fort Myers’ First Street at 6 p.m. Enjoy downtown Fort Myers as local and regional musicians fill First Street with jazz, blues, and rock and roll at a free community music celebration. First Street, Fort Myers. 239-321-7000 or fortmyers.gov.

Back Lot: Goth Night – Music block party and alternative circus at Sidney & Berne Davis Art Center at 7 p.m. Embrace Goth Night at the Back Lot Rave and Rock Circus with live music, flow artists, live art, unique vendors, dark fashion, and a 21+ bar. Tickets are $15.00. 2301 First St., Fort Myers. 239-333-1933 or sbdac.com.

Elvis Through the Years – Free concert at Gulf Coast Town Center’s The Courtyard at 7 p.m. Celebrate Elvis at Gulf Coast Town Center with a live tribute featuring iconic hits, classic rock ’n’ roll, and nostalgic favorites from his career. 9903 Gulf Coast Main St., Fort Myers. gulfcoasttowncenter.com.

Stand-up Comedy: Gid Pool & Jim Moran – Live comedy show at Florida Repertory’s Bunch Performance Hall at 7 p.m. Enjoy live stand-up at Florida Rep with Comedy Zone’s Gid Pool and opening comedian Jim Moran in a laughter-filled performance for those 16 and older. Tickets are $28.00. 2268 Bay St., Fort Myers. 239-332-4488 or floridarep.org.

ThunderBeard: A Tribute to ZZ Top – Live tribute performance at Arts Bonita at 7:30 p.m. Enjoy a high-energy blues-rock tribute packed with powerful riffs, driving grooves, iconic hits, roaring guitars, and authentic rock-and-roll swagger. Tickets start at $45.00.  10150 Bonita Beach Road, Bonita Springs. 239-495-8989 or artsbonita.org.

Candlelight: Coldplay & Imagine Dragons – Live tribute performance at Music & Arts Community Center at 8:30 p.m. Enjoy Coldplay and Imagine Dragons hits by candlelight at the Music & Arts Community Center, performed by Listeso String Quartet. Tickets start at $45.00. 13411 Shire Lane, Fort Myers. 239-277-1700 or gulfcoastsymphony.org.

SATURDAY 10.17

21st Annual Walk to Prevent Child Abuse – Community charity run at Bell Tower Shops with times coming soon. Walk to help prevent child abuse at a family-friendly event featuring fun activities, vendors, and opportunities to raise awareness and support families. Registration is $30.00. 13499 S Cleveland Ave., Fort Myers. 239-580-6777 or belltowerfl.com.

Breakfast with the Birds – Birding event at Edison Ford Winter Estates at 7:30 a.m. Explore the Estates on an easy birding walk with expert guides, then enjoy a complimentary drink and bite at Banyan Cafe with fellow birders. Tickets are $20.00. 2350 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-334-7419 or edisonfordwinterestates.org.

Alliance Morning Market – Local vendor event at Alliance for the Arts at 9 a.m. Explore local vendors, enjoy live entertainment, and catch a free family movie at the Alliance for the Arts’ indoor and outdoor artisan market. 10091 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-939-2787 or artinlee.org.

Oktoberfest Block Party – At Bay Street Yard at 12 p.m. Celebrate Oktoberfest with local craft beer, delicious food, live music, interactive games, prize giveaways, and a chance to vote for your favorite brew. 2136 Bay Street, Fort Myers. 239-940-8744 or baystreetyard.com.

Gulf Coast Youth Orchestra Fall Concert – Live performance at Music & Arts Community Center at 1 p.m. Enjoy the Gulf Coast Youth Orchestra’s Fall Concert at the Music & Arts Community Center, showcasing young musicians in a free live performance. Backyard Bluesfest – Live music at The Buckingham Blues Bar at 2:00 p.m. Enjoy live blues with Albert Castiglia, TLC & BBB, and Big Al & The Heavyweights in a laid-back outdoor setting filled with soulful sounds and energy. Double Feature: Rocky Horror & Summoning the Damned – Film screening at Alliance for the Arts at 5 p.m. Enjoy Rocky Horror under the stars at Alliance for the Arts, plus a preview of the Summoning the Damned haunted maze, all included with one ticket. Tickets start at $30.00. 10091 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-939-2787 or artinlee.org.

Trunk or Treat – Halloween event at First Christian Church at 5 p.m. Bring the family to First Christian Church for a festive gathering where children can collect treats and enjoy a fun, welcoming community celebration. 2061 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-321-7000 or fortmyers.gov.

Florida Everblades vs. Orlando Solar Bears – Hockey game at Hertz Arena at 7 p.m. Watch the Florida Everblades take on the Orlando Solar Bears. Tickets start at $37.75. 11000 Everblades Parkway, Estero. 239-948-7825 or hertzarena.com.

Ryan Biter in Concert – Live performance at St. John’s at 7 p.m. Ryan Biter blends soulful vocals, expressive guitar, and thoughtful songwriting with irreverent humor and raw emotion in a dynamic one-man show. Tickets start at $15.00. 3049 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. americanacma.org.

Quinn Sullivan – Live performance at Arts Bonita at 7:30 p.m. Experience blazing guitar work, soulful vocals, and heartfelt songwriting in a fiery blues-rock performance blending classic roots with modern energy. Tickets start at $40.00.  10150 Bonita Beach Road, Bonita Springs. 239-495-8989 or artsbonita.org.

Press Play: A Gamer’s Halloween Family Concert – Live concert at Barbara B. Mann at 1 p.m. Join Gulf Coast Symphony for a family Halloween concert with treats, hands-on instrument fun, and a costume contest for all ages. Symphony Orchestra – Free performance at FGCU’s U. Tobe Recital Hall at 3 p.m. Enjoy a free orchestral performance at FGCU campus, open to the public with tickets available to reserve through its site. 10501 FGCU Blvd. S., Fort Myers. 239-590-1000 or fgcu.edu.

Tommy Lee Cook & The Buckingham Blues Band – Live music at The Buckingham Blues Bar at 3 p.m. Catch Tommy Lee Cook & The Buckingham Blues Band for a high-energy night of blues, big riffs, and soulful grooves. 5641 Buckingham Road, Fort Myers. 239-693-7111 or buckinghambar.com.

Luminara: The Heart’s Horizon – Fort Myers Symphonic Mastersingers performance at St. Hilary’s Episcopal Church at 4 p.m. Explore love, grace, longing, and hope through an expressive musical journey that celebrates the emotions defining our lives and inspiring our dreams. 5011 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-936-1000 or mastersingersfm.com.

Free Fallin: The Tom Petty Concert Experience – Live tribute performance at Arts Bonita at 7 p.m. Sing along to Tom Petty’s famed hits in a high-energy tribute capturing his legendary sound, signature style, and the raw spirit of his live concerts. MONDAY 10.19

SWFL Stand-up Comedy Studio – At Coastal Dayz Brewery at 6:30 p.m. Join Southwest Florida Stand-Up Studio on Monday nights at Coastal Dayz Brewery for free comedy, beers, friendly pups, and a chance to take the stage. 2161 McGregor Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-204-9665 or coastaldayzbrewery.com.

TUESDAY 10.20

Jodie DeSalvo – Live performance at Tribby Arts Center at 7 p.m. Enjoy beloved piano classics, from Beethoven’s Moonlight Sonata and Debussy’s Clair de Lune to works by Chopin, Liszt, Rachmaninoff, and Gershwins. ONGOING

Fort Myers Farmers Market – Fresh foods farmers market every Sunday from 9 a.m. – 1 p.m. at Downtown Fort Myers’ First Street & Broadway. The Fort Myers Farmers Market returns all summer, bringing fresh local produce, seafood, baked goods, flowers, crafts and more to downtown. 2200 First Street, Fort Myers. 239-321-7000 or fortmyers.gov.

Ping Pong Power – Community wellness program at Estero Recreation Center every Saturday at 2 p.m. Weekly table tennis sessions for seniors, individuals with Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, MS or memory challenges, and caregivers promote fun, fitness, and friendship while improving focus, reflexes, balance, and coordination. 9200 Corkscrew Palms Blvd., Estero. 239-272-8941.

Rooftop Yoga – All levels rooftop yoga at Sidney & Berne Davis Art Center every Tuesday at 6 p.m. Move, breathe, and recharge in an accessible all-levels yoga practice rooted in tradition, community, and joyful self-care. Tickets are $26.00. 2301 First Street, Fort Myers. 239-333-1933 or sbdac.com.

Babcock Ranch’s Halloween Nights – Fall community nights at the Curry Commerce Center available select nights Thursday-Sunday through the month of October. Tickets start at $30.00. 17890 Curry Preserve Drive, Punta Gorda. babcockranch.com.

Reflections in Clay – Alumni art exhibition at FGCU’s Wasmer Art Gallery on display through Nov. 5. Explore how three ceramic artists use clay to reflect on memory, daily rituals, relationships, space, and presence. 10501 FGCU Blvd. S, Fort Myers. 239-590-1000 or fgcu.edu.

Road Trip: It’s the Journal, Not the Destination – Art exhibition at FGCU’s Wasmer Art Gallery on display through Oct. 30. Art Walk: Dark Art – Art exhibit on display at Sidney & Berne Davis Art Center available through Oct. 15. Faces, Places, and Spaces Art Exhibit – Art exhibition at Sanibel Public Library through Nov. 2. Summer showcase featuring works by Sanibel-Captiva Art League artists with pieces available for purchase. Admission is free. 770 Dunlop Rd., Sanibel. sancapart.org.

J – Library Lobby (1st Floor / J-118), Fort Myers. 239-489-9313 or rauschenberggallery.com.

Peter Massing and Selections from the Permanent Collection – Art exhibition at Wilson G. Bradshaw Library, FGCU through Dec. 4. Explore prints and works from the permanent collection featuring artist Peter Massing. 10501 FGCU Blvd. S., Fort Myers. 239-590-7199 or fgcu.edu.
